summary: Dragonheir: Silent Gods released a Halloween promo code, Candytide. Players can redeem the code through the in-game Redemption Code menu to receive rewards directly in their mailbox. The rewards include 5 Heliolite Dice, Mini Stamina Bread, and 5,000,000 Gold. Promo codes are time-limited, so players should claim them promptly.
tips: Enter the redemption code 'Candytide' in the settings menu to receive 5 Heliolite Dice, Mini Stamina Bread, and 5,000,000 Gold before it expires.
title: NEW Promo Code CANDYTIDE – Get 5 FREE Heliolite Dice! | Dragonheir #Shorts
